FamilyHousehold.title: FamilyHousehold
FamilyHousehold.description: Shared synchronized family household document accessed by both the Anchor Parent APK (com.anchor.parent) and Anchor Child APK (com.anchor.child).

householdName.description: Display name of the family household (e.g., The Jenkins Household)

primaryGuardianUid.description: UID of the primary guardian creator

memberUids.description: Authorized guardian and paired child device UIDs

pairingExpiresAt.description: Epoch ms when the pairing code expires

deviceBatteryLevel.description: Current active child device battery percentage (0-100)

lastKnownBatterySync.description: Human-readable or ISO timestamp of last battery telemetry sync

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON state for children, devices, rules, schedules, geofences, alerts, requests, chat, tasks, filters, and consent-based live session state

PairingHandshake.title: PairingHandshake
PairingHandshake.description: Temporary lookup document mapping a 6-digit pairing code to a familyId so a Child App device can pair securely.

createdByUid.description: Guardian UID who issued the code

/families/{familyId}.description: Synchronized family household state shared between Parent App and Child App.

/pairings/{code}.description: Short-lived 6-digit pairing codes for linking Child App devices to a family.
